blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Senate impeachment court on Wednesday voted to revise the 16-vote threshold needed to convict Vice President Sara Duterte in her impeachment trial. The decision came after a majority of senator-judges voted to lower the conviction threshold following oral arguments from the defense and prosecution on the matter. Trial presiding officer Sen. Francis Escudero said the constitutionally required two-thirds vote for conviction will be based only on senators who remain legally and factually capable of participating in the impeachment proceedings at the time of voting.
